# hiok_storage_account_keys (Data Source)

A storage account's two access keys: the password for its file shares (WebDAV, SFTP) and the storage key for the SDKs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key1` (String, Sensitive)
- `key1_scope` (String)
- `key2` (String, Sensitive)
- `key2_scope` (String)
